name: Apply Wall Primer (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall and immediately backroll the wet film. NC production standard for prime. Spray pass is fast, backroll works the primer into mud joints and texture. Single coat regardless of QT. No ceiling cutin needed because spray pattern handles the ceiling line cleanly.
doctrine: Spray primer is meaningfully faster than spray finish (600 vs 390 SF/hr at QT2-3) because primer is thicker and lays down with fewer passes. Backroll keeps pace with the sprayer when smooth, slows on textured surfaces because the roller has to work into the profile. QT4 spray slows to 500 SF/hr because the painter is watching for runs and holidays. No ceiling cutin task — spray handles the ceiling edge cleanly, the finish painter establishes the visible cut line later.
